speaker: char_mentor_frank

all.reason: the Series A road closed by a DECLINE or a WALK, and nothing is left to walk to
EndingsSystem.ACQ_CARD_WINDOW_DAYS - a buyer that never showed up does not show up in year two
the caller IS the seed lead; with no seed there is nobody to make the call

tr.title: END_EV_ACQ_TITLE
tr.body:
Series A turu kapandı, ortada anlaşma yok.

{investor} arıyor.

"Şirketi almak isteyen biri var. {seam:funding.acq_valuation} değerleme ile sana düşen miktar bu: {seam:funding.acq_offer}. Karar senin, ben sadece masaya koyuyorum."

Sonra Frank'ten kısa bir mesaj.

"Hangi kararı verirsen ver arkandayım."

en.title: END_EV_ACQ_TITLE
en.body:
The Series A round is closed and there's no deal in it.

{investor} calls.

"There's someone who wants to buy the company. At a {seam:funding.acq_valuation} valuation, your share comes to {seam:funding.acq_offer}. It's your call. I'm just bringing it to you."

Then a short message from Frank.

"Whichever way you go, I'm behind you."
